findings.claim: The attempt 8 tdd record attributes its own cross-attempt citation to the commit search tolerating the ticket file, but at the tree that record was written against nothing counted had moved at all, so the acceptance came from the exact-tree branch and the tolerance never ran.
findings.failure_scenario: Green 77 recorded tree 804bab59a5d4. A commit reverted the ticket file by exactly the inverse of the commit before it, so its content fingerprint is 804bab59a5d4 as well, and record 88 was written at that head. Replaying cited_check with those records returns at the identity branch: no commit search, no ticket-file substitution, no scoped comparison. A later session, or the calibration asking which record first carried evidence through the procedure-rewrite tolerance, would point at record 88 and find the identity branch instead. The claim becomes true only once the Outcome moved the ticket file again, and the same citation was verified accepted through the scoped path at the delivered tree, so nothing was granted that should not have been.
findings.resolution: Corrected at record 91 and in the Outcome, which now records the distinction rather than the more generous of the two readings: at the tree the tdd record was written against the identity branch granted it and the tolerance never ran, and at the tree being delivered the tolerant path does run and accepts the same pair, both verified by the review. Record 88 is accepted and the journal is append-only, so the note is the correction rather than an edit. The finding cuts the safe way, the gate having accepted on an exactly equal tree rather than on a weaker ground.

The change loosens a stage gate, which is the risk it carries rather than a secret one. Every clause of the loosening was probed adversarially across seven review rounds and the acceptance could not be made to fire loosely: 297 citations in 108 pairs across every journal move no recorded verdict, and the rule refuses its own author's evidence wherever the code it covers has moved.
